title: LIEF 1.0.0 library source, SDK and reproducible first-party binary helper
redistribution: Unmodified pinned Apache-2.0 LIEF SDK and full original source, including published vendored sources. Full available component notices and declared attribution are retained, with explicit build/test source superset. The helper is first-party MIT code, compiled twice identically and statically linked against the unmodified library; only system libc++ and libSystem remain dynamic. It is packaged behind insight-cli binary query/edit-subsystem, not a standalone application requiring another install. Native/independent agent gates are recorded separately. No compiler or SDK is needed by consumers.
